Ending cash from the governmental funds balance sheet Total column (p5): cash and cash equivalents 3,490,826 + county treasurer cash 225,453; certificates of deposit 54,842 in ending_investments; no prior-year cash printed, so beginning_cash null. Business-type from the enterprise funds Total column (pp9-10); Internal Service Fund column (health insurance, governmental activities) excluded. Business-type receipts total computed (operating + nonoperating revenues); disbursements total 4,644,833 = SoA total business-type expenses (p2) = operating 4,642,861 + interest expense 1,972. Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position (p1), Governmental/Business-type columns, component units excluded (governmental funds balance sheet totals 3,771,121 differ from government-wide, which includes capital assets and debt). Detail: General Fund from the departmental combining statement (pp22-23, department columns; more detailed than the General Fund budget schedule pp15-16, which is not recorded); Street, Sales Tax, Debt Service and Capital Projects budget schedules (pp17-20); nonmajor CDBG and Cemetery Perpetual Care funds from the combining statement (p21, no printed totals); proprietary funds by fund column (pp9-10; nonoperating items and transfers outside the printed operating totals). General Fund departmental interest income row is off by 1 (report rounding): report_discrepancies. Read pages 1-23 of 23
